watchme.trigger: read on demand, and materially after any build that adds instance state to a component. The population is the class-space corpus, which exists without arranging anything.
watchme.enough: DELIBERATELY ASYMMETRIC. ONE hand-spelled site standing in a component whose build ran the inspection after this ticket lands is STRONG falsification and satisfies it alone — it says the gate is present and did not bite, which is worse than no gate because a green gate is leaned on. THREE consecutive non-vacuous readings at zero, with at least one taken after a component that needed instance state was built, is WEAK confirmation and also satisfies it. A vacuous scan (files_scanned == 0) counts toward neither and is itself a red: a scan that read nothing reports zero, indistinguishable from a clean corpus at the moment the instrument has stopped working.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, plus the probe's own readings: the site count, the files scanned, and — the half the sibling probe cannot report — whether the sieve is REGISTERED in build_inspector.SIEVES, since a rule deleted from the registry leaves the corpus clean and the gate absent, and those two facts read identically from a count alone.
watchme.nexus: cairn/machines/build_inspector — its how_it_learns surface, where the sieve registry is the thing being measured and probes/does_the_denied_set_stay_put.py already watches the neighbouring question of whether a denied set stays denied.
watchme.consumer: CC at the next build that needs instance state, and the resolver's own watch at cairn/tools/base/probes/hand_spelled_instance_paths.py, which reads the corpus half of the same question without authority.

intention: Make the instance address PHYSICS: a component that spells ~/.cairn by hand instead of asking cairn.tools.base.address is refused at the build inspection, and the seven standing hand-spellings go to zero first so the gate lands on a corpus it does not immediately red. Two halves, in that order. (a) CONVERT ALL SEVEN — four in aider_shim (driver.DEFAULT_DRIVES, fence.DEFAULT_RECORD, venv.VENV, probes/offload_yield_probe.ASK_LOG), ground_loop/discovery.instance_devices_root, and the two the probe called its permanent FLOOR: build_inspector/inspector.py:216 (resolve('instance/devices') has always been the device-across-instances shape, and the import allowlist that held it back was retired on 2026-08-12) and inference_domain/route.py:44 (ruled, and carrying a migration of live state — ~/.cairn/inference/hosts.json moves to ~/.cairn/devices/inference_domain/0/). Then the probe's floor drops to zero and base's charter loses the clause that says nothing refuses an eleventh spelling.
why: THE LIVED SYMPTOM: a resolver nobody is refused for ignoring is a convenience, and the corpus regrows the defect it was built to end. MEASURED, not predicted — on 2026-08-12 ten hand-spelled instance paths were converted down to two; on 2026-08-17 the armed probe measures SEVEN across 162 files and _enough() returns False. One new spelling per day for five days, four of them written by CC inside aider_shim, the device it was actively building, while the probe that names them sat armed and never fired. The cost is the one the resolver's own charter states: provisioning instance 1 of anything means finding and editing every copy, and a shipped app whose root is not under this developer's home directory cannot run at all. AND THE SHARPER WHY, which is about the disposition and not the paths: the probe's floor of two named both sites and both reasons, and both reasons had gone stale — one was answered by a function that predates the probe, the other by a ruling Akien made the same day, recorded two hundred lines away in the same component. A watch whose floor is never re-read goes on clearing against a world that moved.
traces_to: Law 4, by name and in its own words — 'a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy; until it is, it is a tracked debt (an IOU), not a resting state.' base's charter clause (8) states that debt verbatim ('nothing REFUSES an eleventh hand-spelled path... The enforcement is a tracked debt, not a resting state'), so this pays a declared IOU rather than opening a new rule. Law 1 — the resolver exists so a settled address is not re-derived; without a door the re-derivation continued, five times in five days. Law 9 — the red was measured and a deterministic red is fixed or carries a ruling, never a paragraph. Law 3 for the honesty of the close: the probe is the instrument, and the count must read zero by measurement, never by the floor being edited to match.
gates: prove_gate: teeth beside the code at cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/ (the sieve), cairn/tools/base/proofs/ (the corpus reading) and cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/ (the migrated overlay read), each sealed by the tester under netns isolation and persisted through validation_store.persist_validation — the store's own door, never a hand-written trail (a live trouble is on file for that breach, and it recurred twice after being cleared, so it is named rather than assumed). check-type deterministic throughout: the sieve is inference-free by the inspector's own contract, and `cairn determinism` must still read the module PURE DETERMINISTIC after the addition. feedback_gate: a red routes to build_inspector for the sieve half and to cairn/tools/base for the resolver half — never to a converted caller, since every conversion is a mechanical substitution of one expression for an equal one.
falsifier: DONE when all four hold. (a) survey_class_space() reports ZERO sites on a scan that read more than zero files — the count and its denominator together, because a vacuous scan reports zero for the wrong reason. (b) _FLOOR_SITES is empty and _enough() returns True, read from the LIVE corpus and not from a fixture. (c) A PLANTED EIGHTH SPELLING REDS THE INSPECTION — the tooth a hollow build cannot pass, because a sieve that never fires is indistinguishable from no sieve, and after a successful conversion the corpus offers no live offender to demonstrate it on. (d) The two hardest conversions are proved at their own seams: route.py reads hosts.json from the new address, and the offload probe's ASK_LOG equals fence.DEFAULT_RECORD by Path equality rather than by two spellings agreeing. WRONG INTENT if the exemption set cannot be stated as a rule rather than a list of names — the scan must skip address.py, the watcher's own file and proofs/, all three sayable as 'a file whose job is to name or to assert the rule is not an instance of it'. A fourth exemption that cannot be said that way means the sieve has become the hand-widened allowlist that ticket reachability-replaces-the-allowlist retired at this same address, and the honest disposition is to route back to the AST shape.

distinctions_recorded: A DISPOSITIONED RED MUST RE-READ ITS DISPOSITION, OR IT IS JUST A RED WITH A STORY. The probe's floor named two sites and two reasons, and both reasons were stale: 'a device across instances, a shape none of the three rungs fits' when resolve('instance/devices') is that shape and predates the probe; 'its import allowlist is already red' when the allowlist was retired five days earlier by a ticket at that same address. The second site's disagreement had been RULED by Akien on 2026-08-12, and the ruling is recorded two hundred lines from the probe that calls it unsettled. Generalises: a floor is a recorded judgement about the world, and one with no re-read date is how a watch goes on clearing against a world that moved.

CONVERSION WITHOUT A DOOR IS A ONE-TIME CLEANUP, AND THIS IS THE MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN THE PREDICTION. Ten sites to two on 2026-08-12; seven on 2026-08-17. One new spelling per day, four written by CC inside the device it was actively building. The gate is not argued for from principle — the experiment already ran.

THE GATE AND THE WATCH ARE DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS, AND THE FIVE-IN-FIVE-DAYS CASE PROVES IT. A sieve fires on the component being built and structurally cannot see a site in a component nobody is building — one of the five landed in ground_loop, which was not under build. The probe sweeps the whole corpus and carries no authority by construction (Law 6). The probe's floor going to zero is it reading a cleaner world, not it being retired.

THE ONE PLACE A HOLLOW GREEN HIDES, NAMED BEFORE THE BUILD: _FLOOR_SITES can be emptied without converting anything, and _enough() would then return True by moving the goalposts. So the falsifier demands two readings the wrong act cannot both satisfy — floor empty AND a live non-vacuous scan at zero — plus a planted eighth spelling, because a successful conversion leaves the gate with nothing live to prove itself on.

THE PROBE ASKED FOR THIS IMPORT AND COULD NOT HAVE IT. offload_yield_probe.py carries the comment 'Imported rather than re-spelled would be better, and is not possible without dragging the fence's whole import into a module the emission gate loads to READ'. address.py imports pathlib and nothing else — the leanness that was documented as a property is what makes it the answer to a request already written down in the corpus and left unanswered.

NOT IN SCOPE AND SAID SO: the AST-shaped rule (who may name the root at all), rejected for this build because Path.home() has legitimate non-.cairn uses on the very files being converted — venv.py's AIDER_SRC is a held foreign program — so an import-level rule would red a use the address module has no opinion about. Filed as an edge, not smuggled in. Also out and carried forward unchanged from the probe's own cast: the text rule cannot see a path built by concatenation from a variable or by a dynamic join.
